_note: Sector-specific quality overlays. Each entry fires when the stock's sector matches sector_match (regex) AND any risk bullet matches risk_pattern. Used by services/riskLab/quality/sectorQualityOverlay.js to surface idiosyncratic sector risks the generic riskTextClassifier misses.

epc_td_working_capital.summary: EPC / T&D / Power sector working-capital risk — receivables stretch or execution delay common in this vertical

pharma_usfda.summary: Pharma USFDA / regulatory action risk — can permanently impair earnings power

banking_npa.summary: Banking / NBFC asset-quality concern — NPAs or provisioning gap

auto_demand_cycle.summary: Auto demand cycle weakness — dealer inventory or volume risk

realty_cycle.summary: Real estate cycle concern — unsold inventory or project delays
